items.title: BUILDING THE B-24 BOMBER DURING WWII " STORY OF WILLOW RUN " 74182
items.description: Made by the Ford Motor Company during WWII, "The Story of Willow Run" explains the company's role in producing the Consolidated B-24 Liberator heavy bomber.  Narrated by Harry Wismer, the film explains how Ford  manufactured and built B-24 Liberators under license from Consolidated Aircraft Company.
